attempts.summary: Published node2's HTTP service (port 8080) on node1's (OPNsense) LAN address port 80 via a source-restricted DNAT rule limited to node3's IP (10.100.196.12/32), with NAT-reflection helper enabled to fix the same-subnet asymmetric-routing issue, and disabled the port-80 anti-lockout/http-redirect so a reject rule actually takes effect for every other source. Verified node3 gets the proxied content, node2 (a different source on the same LAN) gets TCP connection refused. All three nodes were then restarted one at a time per the mandatory protocol, with boot-identity change and post-restart functional recovery confirmed for each.
